content.title: 'Hard Knocks' to feature Seahawks in 2026, Patriots in 2027 | theScore.com
content.text: Skip to content'Hard Knocks' to feature Seahawks in 2026, Patriots in 2027Daniel Valente2d agoFocus On Sport / Getty Images Sport / GettyThe last two teams standing during the 2025 NFL season will be the next two featured on the training camp edition of "Hard Knocks."The popular HBO series is set to chronicle the Seattle Seahawks' training camp ahead of the 2026 campaign, the team announced Tuesday."Hard Knocks" will then follow the New England Patriots during training camp in 2027, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport. The news was announced Monday night at the NFL's annual league meeting in Phoenix.Neither team has been featured on the show before.The Seahawks defeated the Patriots in Super Bowl LX in February, earning their second-ever Super Bowl victory.Additionally, the Netflix series "Quarterback" will return for a third season in July, according to Rapoport."Hard Knocks" has also aired an in-season edition of the program annually since 2021.TwitterRedditFacebookWhat's AppEmailSMSHEADLINESNFLPA urges NFL to avoid use of replacement officialsTitans add 4 free agents, including quarterback Hooker Goodell has no plans to scrap Rooney Rule despite Florida AG pressureReport: Beckham meets with Giants about potential returnXiaomi co-founder Bin buys 1% of Dolphins at record valuationAdvertisementDaily NewsletterGet the latest trending sports news daily in your inboxEmail addressSubscribeMORE STORIESJaguars to play 2027 home games at Orlando's Camping World S...1d ago•NFL approves 1-year rule to correct mistakes by potential re...1d ago•Raiders' Kubiak lauds Mendoza, prefers not to start a rookie...1d ago•Monken: Browns QB starter reps won't be 'evenly dispersed'1d ago•Fail Mary 2.0?
